---
name: Software or numerical bug
about: Report a reproducible problem using a synthetic case.
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Expected and observed behavior

Describe what happened and what you expected.

## Reproduction

Provide short steps or synthetic settings, including seed, timestep, duration, control and inertia. Attach a bundle only if you can publish all of its contents.

## Environment and diagnostics

State app version, Windows version, source/portable build, browser engine, dependency versions and relevant solver residuals/failures. Remove private paths from logs.
